scroll-vertical.description: The wheel-scroll down 24000px at 8000px/s (Input.synthesizeScrollGesture), with light tracing: frame outcomes from the compositor (PipelineReporter), rAF intervals and Long Animation Frames from the page, main-thread time from CDP.

scroll-vertical-cost.description: The same wheel-scroll down 24000px at 8000px/s, traced in detail (its own pass - the tracing overhead is the same for both builds, but it is kept out of the frame outcomes): busy time of every thread of the frame pipeline (top-level tasks, overlaps counted once) - renderer main, compositor, renderer workers, GPU main, viz - and the paint / raster work in it. With out-of-process raster (the default) the raster itself runs on the GPU process main thread.

scroll-horizontal.description: The wheel-scroll right/left over all columns, 4 sweeps at 4000px/s (Input.synthesizeScrollGesture), with light tracing: frame outcomes from the compositor (PipelineReporter), rAF intervals and Long Animation Frames from the page, main-thread time from CDP.

With out-of-process raster (the default) the raster itself runs on the GPU process main thread.
